story_title: OpenAI, Oracle, and SoftBank Expand Stargate with Five New Sites
caption:
OpenAI, Oracle, and SoftBank have announced five new datacenter sites under Project Stargate, accelerating a $500B, 10-gigawatt U.S. infrastructure buildout.

AI is no longer just a software race. It has officially shifted into a heavy industry war for grid power, real estate, and transformers.

What are your thoughts on compute expanding at utility scale? Comment below.

alt_text_per_slide: Slide 1: $500 BILLION FOR AI.. OpenAI, Oracle, and SoftBank just announced 5 new datacenter sites to accelerate Project Stargate. — shown as a bold statement over a torn-edge color block.

Slide 2: 10 GIGAWATTS OF POWER.. The massive U.S. infrastructure expansion is designed to support power demands for next-generation AI models. — shown as a numbered slide beside a large offset circle.
Slide 3: THREE GIANT PLAYERS.. According to the official release, OpenAI, Oracle, and SoftBank are coordinating the multi-site U.S. buildout. — shown as a numbered slide beside a large offset circle.

Slide 4: TENS OF THOUSANDS OF JOBS.. The construction and operation of these five new sites aim to create significant direct and indirect domestic jobs. — shown as a numbered slide beside a large offset circle.

Slide 5: SOFTWARE IS NOW HEAVY INDUSTRY.. The bottleneck for artificial intelligence is no longer code—it is concrete, turbines, transformers, and land. — shown as a numbered slide beside a large offset circle.
